description: Since 2026-10-03 the float column ALWAYS carries the dilution snapshot's own figure when the snapshot has one: "float" is the measured POINT float (null on a withheld snapshot row), and such a row then carries "floatEstimate" (shares) + "floatEstimateBound" ("point" ~ / "ceiling" <= / "floor" >=) + "floatEstimateBasis" (the working) — present it as the number with its marker, e.g. "<= 7,953,957". minFloat / maxFloat and the computed_float sort compare the figure's VALUE (COALESCE of the two), so a bounded row is kept; a row with neither is NOT MEASURED, never 0. 🔴 Never feed floatEstimate into a market cap, a percent-of-float or a short-interest ratio — a bound is not a point. Screen companies by price range, volume, cash runway, float, shares outstanding (each row's `shares_outstanding` is DATED by `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` (stated / checked / none = date not recorded) and a vendor-free `sharesOutstandingSource`; never present the count without its date), market cap, industry, listing exchange (NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX), float data source and TTM dividend yield. Each row carries dividendYield (trailing-twelve-month cash dividends with an ex-date in the last 365 days / current price, in percent), nextExDate and lastExDate — null means NOT MEASURED or not a payer, never 0%. Sort results by any sortable column. Returns matching companies with key metrics and pagination. Each row carries live trading-halt status (halted/haltCode/haltedAt; false/null when trading normally); pass excludeHalted=true to drop currently-halted tickers from the results.

country.description: Company universe by issuer domicile: "US" (default), "CA" (Canadian companies via their US-OTC/US cross-listings), or "all"

exchange.description: Filter by listing exchange (exact match): NASDAQ, NYSE, or AMEX

excludeHalted.description: When true, exclude tickers with a currently-active trading halt (regulatory or volatility) from the results. Default false — halted rows are included and carry halted/haltCode/haltedAt fields.

industry.description: Filter by company industry (exact match, e.g. "Biotechnology", "Software")

maxCashRunway.description: Maximum estimated months of cash remaining

maxDividendYield.description: Maximum TTM dividend yield in percent. Rows with no measured yield never match.

maxMarketCapComputed.description: Maximum market cap in USD (price * shares outstanding)

maxSharesOutstanding.description: Maximum shares outstanding from SEC EDGAR

minCashRunway.description: Minimum estimated months of cash remaining

minDividendYield.description: Minimum TTM dividend yield in percent (e.g. 3 for 3%). Rows with no measured yield never match.

minMarketCapComputed.description: Minimum market cap in USD (price * shares outstanding)

minSharesOutstanding.description: Minimum shares outstanding from SEC EDGAR

sortBy.description: Column to sort results by (default: volume)
